subject: 🏃 Wednesday — Heavy Strength (Wk 6)
html:
Tomorrow evening: Heavy Strength at Cañada (housekeeper window, after 4:30 PM). Full Rx, all four lifts — but hold all current loads, no progression. Tuesday was a fatigue-flag session — you were mentally and physically tapped from cumulative solo-parenting, Boston jet lag, post-cold residue, and Sunday's suffer-166 long run. The right move is to bank a clean session at current weights, not chase numbers.

Warm-up: Foam roll quads/IT band 1 min each → glute bridges 10 reps → quadruped hip CARs 3 each leg → bodyweight squats 10 reps → RDL pattern with empty bar 10 reps.

ExerciseWeightSets × RepsNotes
Back squat175 lb4 × 63-sec eccentric. Hold — don't bump even if it feels Easy tonight.
RDL165 lb4 × 6Bring straps. Hook grip is a backup, not a substitute.
Standing calf raise155 lb (back-rack barbell)4 × 10Full ROM off a step, 2-sec hold at top, 3-sec lower.
Reverse NordicBodyweight3 × 10Gradual depth build. Glutes locked, hip extension.

The knee has been 1/5 for four straight sessions since the June 3 stair flare — the Week 5 lower-body freeze is expired. But this isn't the session to test that. If everything feels Good, that's the win. If anything feels Heavy, drop 10% and don't think twice — protecting Sunday's 14-miler with 5 mi @ MP is the real priority this week.

Focus cue: control the eccentric. 3-second descent on the squat — hips break first, then knees, smooth all the way down. If you can't hold a clean 3-count, the fatigue is talking. Listen to it.

Context: Week 6 of 12, Phase 2 (Strength & Threshold). Presidio HM is 11 days out — tonight's lift keeps the neural drive alive without digging a hole before the weekend. 46 days to race day.

Pack the straps and lay out gym clothes tonight. Bed by 10 — the sleep debt from this solo-parenting stretch is real, and recovery happens in bed, not in the rack.
